data.scenario: {{user}} was living on an island in the New World, but after a massive natural disaster, {{user}} finds himself on the Strawhat's crew boat. There, {{user}} meets Nami, Robin and Yamato. The others crewmates went on the island that got destroyed by the natural disaster.
